skill.name: brainstorming
skill.description: Guides structured brainstorming before implementation by clarifying context, assumptions, non-functional requirements, options, and decision logs.
skill.summary: Structured brainstorming for turning vague ideas into validated design plans.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Vague feature ideas often hide assumptions, risks, and missing requirements. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through structured brainstorming before implementation starts.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through structured clarification before design starts.
Requires non-functional requirements covering performance, scale, security, reliability, and ownership.
Creates an understanding summary, assumptions list, open questions, and decision log.
Compares two or three design approaches with clear trade-offs.
Presents final designs incrementally and prepares an implementation handoff.
limitations: It does not implement code while brainstorming mode is active.
It depends on explicit user confirmation before moving into design.
It cannot validate production facts without project context.
It may slow simple tasks that need immediate execution.

use_cases.title: Shape Feature Requests
use_cases.description: Turn vague feature ideas into validated requirements, risks, and non-goals before assigning implementation work.

use_cases.title: Review Architecture Options
use_cases.description: Compare design approaches with trade-offs for complexity, extensibility, risk, and maintenance.

use_cases.title: Prepare Design Documents
use_cases.description: Capture assumptions, decisions, open questions, and final design notes in a durable format.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify a New Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for early feature discovery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to help me define a new feature. Ask one question at a time and capture assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Design Paths
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for choosing an approach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me evaluate two or three design approaches for this idea. Include risks, trade-offs, and a recommended option.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for moving from design to implementation planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn our validated design into an implementation handoff. Include the decision log, assumptions, risks, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Facilitate Architecture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for high-impact or risky design work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Facilitate a high-risk architecture review. Confirm requirements first, then present design sections incrementally for approval.

output_examples.input: I want a team dashboard but I am not sure what should be included.
output: Understanding summary: The dashboard should help teams see work status and blockers.
Assumptions: Users need fast scanning, not deep reporting.
Next question: Who is the primary user for the first version?

output_examples.input: We need to redesign our notification system for scale.
output: Recommended approach: Separate notification creation from delivery with a queued workflow.
Trade-off: This adds operational complexity but improves reliability and retry handling.
Decision log: Queue-based delivery selected because delivery failures must not block user actions.

output_examples.input: Prepare this approved design for implementation.
output: Implementation handoff: Build the smallest validated scope first.
Risks: Ownership, testing coverage, and migration timing remain important.
Next step: Confirm task order before coding begins.

best_practices: Share project context and constraints before asking for solution options.
Confirm the understanding summary before reviewing design approaches.
Keep the decision log with the final design document.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to code before the design is accepted.
Do not skip questions when requirements are unclear.
Do not use it for urgent fixes that already have a clear plan.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It blocks implementation while brainstorming mode is active.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before features, architecture changes, behavior changes, or complex functionality.

faq.question: Does it require project files?
faq.answer: No, but project context improves the quality of questions and recommendations.

faq.question: How does it handle uncertainty?
faq.answer: It records assumptions and open questions before design decisions are made.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it create final documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare a design summary, assumptions, decision log, and handoff.
